traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION are fully implemented and verified. The core helpers now support dual-position annotation detection for CatchClause (before-catch and first comments inside the body) with correct priority and fallback behavior. Auto-fix logic inserts annotations inside the catch body to align with Prettier’s formatting, and this is validated by both unit tests and Prettier-based integration tests. Internal rule documentation and the user-facing API reference explicitly describe the supported CatchClause annotation positions and formatter compatibility. The overall Jest test suite passes, including all tests that directly exercise the behavior required by this story. Therefore, the story is considered PASSED.
